content: InstructorLite 1.3.0 (latest on hex.pm as of 2026-07-26) is the current version; hex.pm confirms 72k all-time downloads, GitHub repo martosaur/instructor_lite, MIT license. Gemini adapter usage: InstructorLite.instruct(%{contents: [%{role: "user", parts: [%{text: ...}]}]}, response_model: Schema, json_schema: %{type: "object", required: [...], properties: %{...}}, adapter: InstructorLite.Adapters.Gemini, adapter_context: [api_key: ...]). v1.2.0 switched the Gemini adapter internally to the responseJsonSchema param (still requires the caller to pass json_schema explicitly). v1.3.0 updated the Gemini adapter's default model to gemini-3.5-flash-lite.
